name: Wedges
summary: Open-source React UI component library plus a free Figma design system, built on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS.
description: Wedges is an open-source, MIT-licensed React UI library built with Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript support, with dark mode and theming included. A matching free Figma design system and UI kit adds components, variants, variables, a 4px grid and 200 bundled icons; install guides cover Next.js, Vite, Remix, Gatsby, Astro, Laravel and manual setups.
contains: open-source React component library, MIT licensed
matching free Figma design system and UI kit, updated monthly
components include button, input, select, alert, avatar, badge, tabs, switch, slider, tooltip and progress
install guides for Next.js, Vite, Remix, Gatsby, Astro, Laravel and manual
Figma kit ships variables, variants, a 4px grid and 200 icons
